title: Stacked stop + clock
description: Stop-name and clock stack vertically on the left as two lines, with the theme toggle vertically centered on the right — a two-line header instead of a single wide row.
baseline_ref: app/pages/index.vue .screen__header (grid 1fr auto auto: route | clock | toggle)

changes.intent: Switch to a two-row grid: left column holds route then clock stacked, right column holds the toggle spanning both rows.
Place route/stop on row 1, left column.
Place clock on row 2, directly under the stop name.
Span both rows on the right column and center vertically so it doesn't look tied to either line specifically.
